funding_notes: Unitary (unitary.ai), London company founded 2019 at EF by Sasha Haco and James Thewlis; began in AI video content moderation and has since pivoted to 'Virtual Agents' automating operations work (matches EF description). Raised ≈ $24.7M equity: £1.35M seed led by GFC (2020), $8M led by Plural (Mar 2023; Plural's Ian Hogarth described it as a $10M seed), $15M Series A led by Creandum (Oct 2023). Total uses ~$1.7M for the £1.35M round.
